full_judgment:
Mustafa Kamal, J.: This appeal by special leave by the defendant-appellants is from the second appellate judgment and decree of a learned Single Judge of the High Court Division, Comilla Bench, dated 29.1.84 in Second Appeal No. 234 of 1979 reversing those of the learned District Judge, Noakhali, dated 21.12.78 in Title Appeal No. 29 of 1973 passed in reversal of those dated 13.1.73 in O.C. Suit No. 61 of 1971, by the learned Subordinate Judge, Noakhali, decreeing the suit. 

 7. The High Court Division reversed the finding of the first appellate Court on the ground, as already noticed, that there was no reversal of the trial Court's material findings on some points. It was, therefore, not a proper judgment of reversal, the High Court Division held. 

 9. Leave was granted to consider the submission that first appellate Court reversed the judgment of the trial Court on the ground that the plaintiff failed to prove his alleged title and possession. It found that Sekander Miah was a bonafide purchaser for consideration by kabala Ext. A executed by Syed Ahmed who did not surrender the tenancy and that the heirs of Sekander Miah were still in possession. Those were findings of fact which have not been reversed by the High Court Division in accordance with well-settled principles. It was not proper judgment of reversal of the judgment of the final court of fact.
